hypothesis: Cataloguing is a biased sample of the fault population: a cell is catalogued if an interpreter found it convincing, which correlates with relief, slope, gravity signature, lidar coverage and distance to a range front. Modelling that sampling propensity e(x)=P(labeled|fault,x) and weighting the risk by 1/e recovers new faults that the cataloguing process under-samples, better than an unweighted nnPU model on the same folds.
mechanism: SAR-EM (Bekker & Davis, PMLR v94): a classifier is fit on the propensity-weighted empirical risk of Bekker, Robberechts & Davis (arXiv:1809.03207), weight-clipped at 10, alternating with a propensity model fit on the catalogued cells only over five predeclared covariates. Emission is a descending sweep of expected credit with non-maximum suppression at the metric's own 3 px kernel radius, a budget taken from a measured curve, and a final prune of dots inside 2 px of the mapped catalogue.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Lithology contrast: a map-unit boundary traced as a line can be a false positive wherever it is not a fault. The gravity-derived basin-fill covariate is the specific confound this lane cannot separate from a real segment, because basin margins and range fronts are where faults live.
LiDAR acquisition footprint: a scarp-like signal can appear at tile seams. The lidar_coverage covariate exists to absorb this, but a seam inside a covered tile is not modelled.

Mapped-lineament bias: the catalogue itself contains lineaments drawn from imagery, so any model trained on it inherits the interpreter's geometric habits. Non-maximum suppression limits, but does not remove, this.

emission.rule: accept candidates in descending expected credit with non-maximum suppression at the metric's 3 px kernel radius, budget taken to saturation on the measured curve, then prune every dot within 2.0 px of a mapped fault

prune.rule: drop dots within 2.0 px of a mapped fault

negative_results: Forbidding the 3 px halo around mapped faults before allocation lowers holdout DTI at all three arms: 0=0.068479, 2=0.061535, 3=0.055396, 4=0.050362
The model's own surrogate price curve preferred 64,000 dots; the evaluator preferred more. The surrogate was demoted to a diagnostic.
SCAR (constant propensity) is cleanly worse than both PU arms, at every budget measured, which is the rejection of the null this lane exists to test.
